card.fact_statement: Álvaro Delgado of the Republican Coalition was the main opponent defeated in the runoff.
card.source_span: Yamandú Orsi of the Broad Front defeating Álvaro Delgado of the Republican Coalition.

target_qa_variants.question: ¿Quién fue el principal oponente de la Coalición Republicana derrotado en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones generales de Uruguay de 2024?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Yamandú Orsi of the Broad Front defeating Álvaro Delgado of the Republican Coalition.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'runoff' as 'segunda vuelta', which is the standard Spanish term for electoral runoffs (though 'balotaje' is also common in Uruguay).

backtranslation_en.question: Who was the main opponent of the Republican Coalition defeated in the second round of the 2024 general elections of Uruguay?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Spanish translation accurately reflects the English source question, asking for the defeated Republican Coalition opponent in the 2024 Uruguayan election runoff.
